method_notes.entry_price: the market's official last_price_dollars at collection time
method_notes.payout: contracts x $1 when the held side equals the official result, else $0
method_notes.drawdown: largest peak-to-trough decline of the cumulative net P&L in settlement order
method_notes.no_estimates: no open market is booked; only official results settle a trade

caveats: The Kalshi demo environment uses mock funds; its prices and behaviour may not reflect real markets (https://docs.kalshi.com/getting_started/demo_env).
The entry price is the last traded price at collection time, not the price a real order would necessarily have received.
One contract set per market; no position sizing, no partial fills, no slippage beyond the published fee.
A positive ROI on demo data is not evidence of a profitable strategy on the live exchange.
Most resolved in-scope demo markets are short-dated crypto contracts that settle every few minutes, so the topic mix is not representative of a real book.
